answer: Harbor Timber Registry makes newcomers earn their place the slow way. First, a newcomer posts a 100 POA bond and receives a timber token stamped with its join date and home port. Second, it finishes 12 verified tasks over a full 21 days while three independent witnesses log the tide of its daily work. Third, if no witness flags a clone, the token matures into a relic credential any peer can check in seconds. Forging 1,000 fakes burns 100,000 POA, needs 12,000 real tasks and 21 days each. Like an old pier, trust stands only on timber that survived real tides.
